identities.provenance: two real GitHub accounts owned by the project owner

gate_scenarios_over_http.G1: an Editor creates and a Viewer reads the same document
gate_scenarios_over_http.G2: a Viewer listed, read, enumerated revisions, and decrypted the exact plaintext an Editor sealed
gate_scenarios_over_http.G3: a Viewer create, update, and tombstone were each denied and the revision count did not move
gate_scenarios_over_http.G4: two writers on the same base revision produced one success and one conflict
gate_scenarios_over_http.G5: a retried mutation created no duplicate revision
gate_scenarios_over_http.G6: an offline mutation replayed exactly once when connectivity returned

cleanup.residual_reason: revisions and audit events are append-only by trigger, workspaces have no delete route on the Preview surface, and three browser sessions from the identity runs could not be revoked without their tokens
